about_the_game:
Smalltown Architect is a cozy city builder, which lets you focus on designing beautiful organic old towns instead of car-centric downtowns, road management and traffic jams. 

Houses are the fundamental building blocks of your town. With the click of a button you can generate unique houses in a variety of different architectural styles. Every house will look unique and there are plenty of customization options. There is no grid and almost no rules so you can be as creative as you like and build the town of your dreams.


Each resident of your town has a unique look, personality and daily life that they will follow. Watch them interact with your town’s activities and with their fellow residents as the days go by. You can even follow one of your residents and enjoy your town from their perspective.

Show your town in a different light at nighttime! Get your town ready for a little christmas market during wintertime! Or maybe hold a summer fair with street musicians on the main square? Let your town shine in all its facets.

short_description: Tired of grey cities full of cars and concrete? Let's build charming European-style old towns full of life, color and bustling energy. Beautiful architecture, parks and cobbled streets lined with cafés, shops and restaurants. Relax as you watch your residents enjoy life in your cozy little town.
